flags.title: Valuation blind-spot
flags.note: Rich valuation — DCF overvalued 180%. A market-beating chart doesn't make a rich entry safe; the price already discounts a lot of the good news.
flags.lesson: KPIT: strong EV/software story, valuation ignored → about −30%.

flags.title: Sector tailwind
flags.note: Capital Goods is in a TAILWIND (tailwind score +0.63) — the macro backdrop supports the setup.
flags.lesson: Focus on cycles and change, not insider chatter (the author's actual edge).

flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

threats.point: A premium multiple versus peers can unwind quickly if growth slips.
A price that has outrun earnings needs the growth to catch up or it de-rates.
Management noted that 5-axis machines involve complex legalities and restrictions that can choke production or distribution lines if used for defense purposes.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "If this kind of machine is used in the defence purpose, then our entire production line will choke up because some of the European and Japanese companies will not give us the material." (concall transcript - 2026-10-01)
